answer: The three approaches to feature engineering listed in the lecture are: 1) Feature selection: selecting the most useful features to train on among existing features [uow_ai_ml_p019_paragraph_001]; 2) Feature extraction: combining existing features to produce a more useful one [uow_ai_ml_p019_paragraph_001]; 3) Creating new features by gathering new data [uow_ai_ml_p019_paragraph_001].
